title: nf-core/diseasemodulediscovery pipeline - params.input schema
description: Schema for the file provided with params.input

seeds.errorMessage: The seed file cannot contain spaces and must end with .(txt|csv|tsv)

network.errorMessage: The network must be a keyword referring to an inbuilt network, or a file ending with .(gt|csv|tsv|graphml|xml|dot|gml), and cannot contain spaces
